intermediate.name: Corno alle Scale
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Corno alle Scale (184 km)

story: After a long battle to form the breakaway, eight riders eventually went clear without any of the major favorites represented. Giulio Ciccone and two others bridged across in the second half of the stage as Decathlon CMA CGM controlled the gap behind. Ciccone and Einer Rubio emerged as the final survivors at the front, before Ciccone attacked solo with 7.6 kilometers remaining. In the favorites’ group, Felix Gall launched an attack that was followed by Jonas Vingegaard, and the pair eventually reeled Ciccone back in. Vingegaard then accelerated again inside the final kilometre to take a solo victory.
